'''Enrique Pascual''' finished 6th at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec-sun">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Sunday semi-final results], Decipher (7 December 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427191534/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gameresults2.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was a finalist at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]. Pascual qualified through Ithor Madrid from Madrid, Spain.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Pascual won the [[1997 Ithor Regionals (Barcelona)]], a qualifier for the 1997 Worlds.<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Decipher's 1997 World Finals page listed Enrique Pascual as 19 years old and said a biography was unavailable.<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/pascual.html Enrique Pascual], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428025827/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/pascual.html Internet Archive]</ref>
